note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and B-L numbers exist for Feb 2026 shipments to Kazakhstan, Argentina, Jordan, Turkey and UAE, plus 289 total records and 28 port lanes. Declared HS set (291570;293399;293499;330129) is only partly matched by observed records — 29157090 (magnesium stearate) matches; observed 29420090, 29072200, 28230010, 29224990 are outside the declared set, so the actual HS profile is broader than declared (per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; code should be corrected to observed actuals). Note the free view mixes directions: the 'Suppliers' block shows RIA INTERNATIONAL LLC (NJ, USA) as a counterparty with 132 shipments, so some of the 289 records may be imports into India rather than exports — direction per row should be confirmed on a paid view. Domestic (in-India) supply evidence: none retrieved, status unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of access, not absence of supply. Revenue/export volume figures: null, not public in free sources.
